body.x: Innopresso will participate in the world’slargest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 toshowcase its touchpad-integrated keyboard Mokibo.

Innopresso is a company that studies how to teach and expand the input device Mokibo, which will become the next mainstream. Mokibo is an integrated keyboard with the ability to convert from a plain mechanical keyboard plane to a large touchpad. Since the mechanical keyboard touch is preserved, fast typing is made possible. In addition, since the touchpad is three times larger than the typical notebook touchpad, it is highly usable as a portable keyboard, a tablet PC keyboard, and a laptop keyboard module.

Major features are as follows. △ Converts the keyboard itself into a large touch pad △ Integrated keyboard with the smallest product size even though it has the largest keyboard size among integrated keyboard and the largest touch pad size △ Less arm movement when switching between keyboard and mouse modes △ Shortest switching time between keyboard mode and mouse mode

The official said, “We are looking for channels to distribute Mokibo in the US, Europe and China. I also want to meet large and small notebook manufacturers and keyboard makers, including Logitech, HP, Lenovo, Dell, Asus, Aser, Apple, Samsung and MSI.” He continued, “We are designing Mokibo's next product line and developing Mokibo foldable, Mokibo typing cover, and Mokibo minibook."

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
